requirement_alignment: Actual PNG inspected; all visible text English, real observed costs, negative values retained.
data_expression_quality: Exact signed costs with explicit thousand CNY units; no synthetic data or fitted trends.
style_preservation: Original template source read: serif typography, gradient bars/gray grid or marked lines and bars preserved.
readability: Monthly labels and legend are legible, no clipping or overlap observed.
layout_quality: Monthly title, legend, plot and note bands are separate.
color_quality: Distinct bar and line colors and markers; zero is explicit.
